reportedBehavior: System background audio becomes silent after petalDrop, restoring only on the next flower.
confirmedSourceDefect: The previous AudioPlayerController had no natural-completion cleanup; started remained true until next-round cleanup.
diagnosticLimit: No device focus dump, audio recording or native logs; controller lifetime matches the symptom, but a particular native focus flag is unconfirmed.

changes.playback: One Android MODE_STATIC AudioTrack preloaded per round; exact PCM16 samples cached per scene.
changes.spatialBinding: SDK 6.2.8 public SpatialAudioTrackExtension, OBJECT mode, attached to independent tear emitter.
changes.completion: Final sample marker explicitly stops the track. Duration + 250 ms watchdog stops it if callback is lost; scheduling depends on the main looper.
changes.rapidCues: Stop/rewind before play; generation tokens reject old completion/timeouts; playback head rejects an old marker delivered to a new listener.
changes.pause: Stops and cancels callbacks, no delayed resume.
changes.teardown: Cancel optional preparation job (unchanged scene); stop, unregister listener/marker/watchdog, release track and spatial extension, destroy emitter.
changes.triggerAndPosition: Unchanged successful detach before reparent/rebound, crown.convertPositionTo(spec.position, root) in RoseAnchor meters.
changes.preparation: Unchanged optional post-Ready job with two real frame waits; exceptions cannot clear flower or set Error.
changes.acousticDefaults: OBJECT bridge platform defaults; prior ObjectAudioComponent attenuation and reverb settings are not asserted for this bridge.
